overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Platform activity and system health at a glance.
overview.sessionsHint: Signed-in devices that have not signed out or expired.

list.noResults: Nothing matches your search. Try a shorter term.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone who has an Upvine account.
users.caption: Users

user.noMemberships: This user is not a member of any organization.
user.impersonateHint: Opens the dashboard exactly as this user sees it. Read-only, ends after 30 minutes and is recorded in the audit log.
user.grantAdminBody: Admins can see every user and organization and view any account. Only give this to people who work on Upvine.
user.revokeAdminBody: They will lose access to the admin panel immediately.
user.revokeSessionsBody: Use this if you suspect someone else has access to the account. They will need to sign in again.
user.sessionsRevoked: The user has been signed out on all devices.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.description: Every workspace and its subscription status.
orgs.caption: Organizations
orgs.name: Organization

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Sign-ins, security events and every admin action.
audit.caption: Audit log entries

soon.refunds: Refund requests from the 14-day guarantee will appear here for review (phase 3).
soon.invoices: Payments that need an e-Arşiv or e-Fatura invoice will be listed here with CSV export (phase 3).
soon.queues: Background jobs for writing, publishing and tracking will be monitored and retried here (phase 1).
soon.aiCosts: AI usage and cost per customer, compared with revenue, will appear here (phase 1).
soon.flags: Prompt template versions and feature flags will be managed here (phase 6).

entitlements.title: Plan and entitlements
entitlements.description: Grant a plan without payment (Agency for full access) or set a custom monthly article allowance. Every change is written to the audit log.
entitlements.paidNote: This organization has a paid subscription; the plan can’t be changed here, only an extra article allowance and a note.
entitlements.planHint: Trial: no plan (3 articles a month, 1 site).
entitlements.quotaHint: Leave empty to use the plan’s allowance. 0–1000.
entitlements.quotaInvalid: Enter a whole number between 0 and 1000.
entitlements.expiresHint: Empty means no end date. When it ends, entitlements return to the trial.
entitlements.noteHint: Why it was granted (e.g. pilot customer, partner).

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Messages from the contact form. A new message is marked as read when you open it.
messages.name: Full name
messages.empty: No messages yet. Messages from the contact form appear here.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Blog posts on the website. Each post is published in one language.
blog.newDescription: Save it as a draft, add a cover and publish when it’s ready.
blog.empty: No posts yet. Add your first one with "New post".
blog.statusHint: Drafts aren’t visible on the site.
blog.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. Don’t change it after publishing; old links will break.
blog.excerptHint: Shown in the blog list and in search results when the meta description is empty (up to 320 characters).
blog.seoHint: If left empty, the title and short summary are used.
blog.deleteBody: The post disappears from the site and the list. Its address can be used for a new post.

cover.title: Cover image
cover.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF; at least 600×300 px, up to 10 MB. The image isn’t cropped; it’s resized to 1600 px wide.
cover.altHint: A short description for people who can’t see the image.
cover.invalid: This file can’t be used. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF of at least 600×300 px and up to 10 MB.
cover.saveFirst: Save the post first to add a cover image.

billing.title: Payments
billing.description: Card and bank transfer orders. When a transfer reaches the account, open the order and approve it; the plan opens immediately.
billing.testMode: This order was created in test mode (PayTR test mode or the test bank account): no real charge.
billing.name: Name / company
billing.approveHint: Approve if you see a payment of {{amount}} with {{reference}} in the reference on your bank statement.
billing.noteHint: For example, which account it arrived in. Saved to the audit log.

testimonials.title: Customer testimonials
testimonials.description: The "What our customers say" section on the home page. Write a testimonial in one language; it is translated into the others automatically.
testimonials.newDescription: Translation starts when you save. Published testimonials appear on the home page.
testimonials.empty: No testimonials yet. Add your first customer testimonial.
testimonials.author: Author
testimonials.authorTitleHint: E.g. Founder, Smile Dental Clinic. Optional.
testimonials.websiteHint: Optional. The domain is shown as a link on the home page.
testimonials.quoteHint: Up to 600 characters. The customer's own words, with their permission.
testimonials.languageHint: Translations are made from this language.
testimonials.statusHint: A published testimonial appears on the home page in every language whose translation is ready.
testimonials.deleteBody: The testimonial and all its translations are deleted permanently and removed from the home page.
testimonials.translationsHint: You can correct the AI translation. A translation you edit is kept even if the testimonial changes.
testimonials.translationReset: This language will be translated again.

translationErrors.ai_not_configured: AI is not configured. You can write the translations by hand.
translationErrors.ai_budget: The daily AI budget is used up. Try again tomorrow or translate by hand.
translationErrors.ai_unavailable: The AI service is not responding right now. Try again in a moment.
translationErrors.ai_blocked: The AI refused to translate this text. You can translate it by hand.
translationErrors.ai_invalid_output: The translation came back incomplete. Try again.
translationErrors.internal: The translation could not be made. Try again.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Leads and the Instagram plan. Nothing is sent by the system: copy the text and send it from your own account.
sales.doNotContactHint: Hidden from lists and no follow-up reminders.

actions.exportFailed: The CSV could not be downloaded. Try again.
actions.cleanupBody: Leads older than 12 months with the status "Not interested" are permanently deleted with their history.

table.caption: Leads
table.name: Business
table.emptyAll: No leads yet. Add a lead or import JSON.

import.title: Import JSON
import.body: Choose a file in the seed-data.json format. You see what will be added first; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.modeHint: Status, notes and the sent date never change.
import.invalidJson: The file could not be read: it is not valid JSON.

lead.newDescription: The domain is taken from the website address; the same domain cannot be added twice.
lead.messagesHint: [Adın] in the text is replaced with your name when you copy. Send the message from your own email or account.
lead.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
lead.name: Business name
lead.websiteHint: The domain is taken from this address.
lead.findingHint: A concrete gap found on the site, 1-3 sentences.
lead.deleteBody: The lead and its entire history are permanently deleted.

posts.newDescription: After saving, copy the text and post it in Meta Business Suite.
posts.title: Title
posts.formatHint: For example Single image, Carousel (5 slides), Reels (15-30 s).
posts.caption: Caption
posts.copyHint: The caption and hashtags are copied together.
posts.deleteBody: The post is permanently removed from the plan.
